package parsers

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ParseTaskFilters parses task filters from query parameters with validation.
func ParseTaskFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.TaskFilters, error) {
	var result filters.TaskFilters

	var err error
	if result.ID, err = parseStringParam(r, "id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.LessonID, err = parseStringParam(r, "lesson_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Title, err = parseStringParam(r, "title", validator, "max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	statusRule := fmt.Sprintf("oneof=%d %d",
		domain.TaskStatusNoActive,
		domain.TaskStatusActive,
	)
	if result.Status, err = parseIntParam(r, "status", validator, statusRule); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	pageRule := fmt.Sprintf("min=%d,max=%d", filters.MinPage, filters.MaxPage)
	if result.Page, err = parseIntParam(r, "page", validator, pageRule); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	limitRule := fmt.Sprintf("min=%d,max=%d", filters.MinLimit, filters.MaxLimit)
	if result.Limit, err = parseIntParam(r, "limit", validator, limitRule); err != nil {
		return filters.TaskFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Page == nil {
		defaultPage := filters.DefaultPage
		result.Page = &defaultPage
	}
	if result.Limit == nil {
		defaultLimit := filters.DefaultLimit
		result.Limit = &defaultLimit
	}

	return result, nil
}
